name: PartyStatus_ApplyToRecords
summary: Writes the cached party snapshot back into the live save: copies the bag block and per-member HP/MP, level/EXP, equipment and inventory slots, re-applying items through Member_RemoveItemAtSlot/Member_SetItemAtSlot.
evidence: Mirror of 0x00210044; copies GameWork+0x24AC0 and 0x274C bag block, then per-slot restores member fields via Member_RemoveItemAtSlot/Member_SetItemAtSlot/Party_Member_EquipInventorySlot.

name: MenuActor_ApplyModelOverride
summary: Applies a model-attachment override to the menu actor's scene-sprite set: resolves the override by id through Model_Attach_ApplyOverrideByName and, on success, applies the identity-matrix block.
evidence: Only caller Menu_InitFromParams; callees Gfx_SceneSpriteSet_GetGroupB and Model_Attach_ApplyOverrideByName; identity matrix block passed to func_0061E700.

name: PartyStatus_SaveSnapshot
summary: Saves live party state into the snapshot block: copies GameWork+0x24AC0 and the 0x274C bag block, then per member stores actor id, HP/MP, level/EXP and six equipped-slot item ids.
evidence: Field-for-field mirror of 0x0020FE1C; reads member HP/MP/level/EXP and equipment via func_006292F0/func_006297C8; callers Menu_InitFromParams and Battle_UpdateUnitDisplay.

name: Menu_ApplyActorModelPattern
signature: void Menu_ApplyActorModelPattern(MenuState* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
summary: When f_424A is set, walks the four actor lists and applies each slot record's pattern id to the actor model via vtable +0xA0, then asks the scene transition controller to refresh.
evidence: Only caller Menu_InitFromParams; vtable +0xA0 model getter and f_34E4/f_34E6 id pair; calls func_002AEA84 on work+0x74.

name: maybe_Menu_AdvanceListCursor
signature: int maybe_Menu_AdvanceListCursor(MenuState* self, int entryList, unsigned actor, unsigned mode)
summary: Per-page cursor step over a modulo-6 list, with case 3 dispatching the selected row; the switch is partly destroyed by bad instruction data.
evidence: halt_baddata and overlapping instructions; callers Menu_CalcEquipStatValues and Menu_EvalEntryCondition use result as index; role only partly trustworthy.

name: maybe_Model_ApplyResourceAppearance
signature: void maybe_Model_ApplyResourceAppearance(void* self, void* entry, void* params)
summary: Applies a character-model resource entry to a model view: resolves cblm/cbhm base names and _mant material, copies scale/offset/colour/socket parameters and links the joint transform when a skeleton is bound.
evidence: Callers Model_ReleaseResource and Gfx_Model_AttachGadgetMesh; cblm/cbhm/base_mant literals and Model_FindEntryById visible; decompilation heavily damaged.

name: maybe_Pack_DecodeResource
signature: void maybe_Pack_DecodeResource(int pack, u32 offset, u32 size, u32 flags)
summary: Large pack-resource decode/initialise routine: allocates through CRT memory helpers, initialises a critical section and submits GPU commands.
evidence: Callers Ui_InitCommonResources, Ui_ScrollListWindow_Ctor, Ui_ListWindow_Ctor1F8; callees are memory/command/critical-section helpers; nothing proves the resource kind.

name: maybe_Ui_GuideWindow_ChangePage
summary: Page-change handler of the guide window: advances the page counter and pushes the page-number message; body partly destroyed.
evidence: Only named caller Ui_GuideWindow_UpdateState; halt_baddata/coprocessor damage and unaff_r6/r7 registers.

name: maybe_Monster_FieldBehaviour_UpdatePhysics
summary: No dossier or decompiled body is available, so the existing physics-update guess cannot be checked.
evidence: No readable file; nothing to verify against.

name: Field_SceneObject_ConsumeTriggerRecordB

params.sceneObj: scene object whose secondary trigger block is filled

summary: Clears the secondary trigger block on a scene object, then if the record's save bit is still unset copies the 8-byte field trigger record's four u16 fields into the object, marks the bit used and returns 1; otherwise flags 'no record' and returns 0.
evidence: Uses the established trio 0x0066B3B0 (test save bit), 0x0063DCE8 (fetch 8-byte trigger record), 0x006125F0 (set bit) on (work+0x24A98)+0x5418; five named Field_SceneObject/Field_Marker/Field_Gadget callers.

name: Gfx_ServiceDisplayTransfer
signature: int Gfx_ServiceDisplayTransfer(u32* outA, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, int* outB, u32* outC, u32 arg6, u32 arg7, u32 arg8)
summary: Display-transfer state machine: submits Gfx_TransferGpuBuffer, spins on transient GSP status codes, maps the final code to an engine display state and drives enable/disable transitions via Gfx_IpcCmd50100.
evidence: Loops on Gfx_TransferGpuBuffer with GSP status set; callers are Gfx_UpdateDisplayState/Gfx_UpdateDisplayStateB/Gfx_WaitForIpcIdle; writes g_engineSubsystemInitState.

name: Gfx_WaitSyncSubmitNoLock
signature: int Gfx_WaitSyncSubmitNoLock(u32 request, u32 arg2, u32 arg3)
summary: Lock-free inner half of Gfx_WaitSyncSubmit: waits for the display/IPC state to leave transient values, then sends the request via Svc_SendRequest2, retrying on the 0xC8A0CC02/0xE0A0CC08/0xC8A0CFF0 busy results with a 10,000,000-tick sleep; returns the final result.
evidence: Same three busy result codes as sibling Gfx_WaitSyncSubmit; calls Gfx_WaitForIpcIdle, Svc_SendRequestByte/Svc_SendRequest2 and Os_UnlockScheduler; no callers.

name: Err_WaitForIpcIdleOrFatal
summary: Retries Gfx_WaitForIpcIdle(0) while it reports a negative non-fatal result, sleeping 10 ms on 0xE0A0CC08 and stopping on success or on the err:f sentinel 0xC8A0CFFC.
evidence: Loop constants are the err:f family (0xC8A0CFFC) and 0xE0A0CC08 with 0x00989680 ns = 10 ms sleep; callee Gfx_WaitForIpcIdle; called from Fs_* path builders and Fs_Stream_OpenByPath.

name: maybe_FieldParty_MemberAction_PlayEmote
summary: Member-action state machine (states 0x1EEB/0x1EFD/0x1F07): looks up the member's sound id from the actor record (+0xE8A), plays it, spawns the emote popup and later plays popup 0x2B once the actor is idle.
evidence: Sound lookup + Sound_PlaySeById + Ui_PopupEntry_SpawnForModelActors sequence is readable, but there is no caller and only the state ids link it to the member-action class.

name: maybe_FieldParty_MemberAction_SpawnInfoPopup
summary: Member-action state machine: on its first state (0xE10) it builds a popup-entry descriptor from the member id (+0x48C), the actor record and its name/portrait fields, then requests the popup; the next state (0xE1C) finishes the action.
evidence: State words 0xE10/0xE1C, func_0063FD24 action rows and Ui_PopupEntry_SpawnForModelActors are readable, but no caller names the action family.

name: maybe_Battle_Ui_HideMemberBalloons
summary: Clears the balloon flag on every visible member slot (unless the UI is in hidden mode) so the balloons disappear for this frame.
evidence: Loops func_00630DC8() slots calling vtable +0x48 and clearing one flag byte per member; only caller is Field_Gimmick_CheckActiveNodes, so the battle-UI attribution is unverified.

name: maybe_FieldParty_MemberAction_WaitForActor
summary: Member-action state 0x33: polls a virtual predicate on the owning object and returns 1 once satisfied, otherwise keeps waiting; also queues a battle message via Battle_MessageQueue_PushEntry.
evidence: State constant 0x33, vtable +0x24 poll, Battle_MessageQueue_PushEntry and Os_GetGameWork callees; no caller and no named callee fixes the member-action attribution.

name: maybe_Battle2DUnit_ShowActionPopup
summary: Same body as 0x00590B28 with state constant 0x82 instead of 0x33: polls a virtual predicate, triggers motion 0x79 and pushes a popup descriptor {kind=6} to the battle message queue.
evidence: Identical structure to 0x00590B28 (vtable +0x24 poll, motion 0x79, popup kind 6, Battle_MessageQueue_PushEntry); no caller and class only inferred from address range.

name: maybe_BattleScene_UpdateActionAnimation
summary: Drives per-action battle animation: when the action id changes to the attack code it plays the matching sound/effect for every unit and advances the animation.
evidence: Action-id compare (self->f_134 vs -1 and 0x38E), four-list walk over battle work +0x428C stride 0x1C, model-vtable calls; no caller or named callee fixes the scene class.

name: maybe_Battle_UpdateStateCallbacks
signature: uint32_t maybe_Battle_UpdateStateCallbacks(BattleManager* self, uint32_t arg2, uint32_t arg3, uint32_t arg4)
summary: Dispatches the manager's per-state callbacks on the phase byte (+0x2F0): vtable +0x1A4 when both phase counters agree, +0x1A0 for state +0x103 and +0x19C for state 3.
evidence: Phase compares (+0xFD/+0x40/+0x103/3) and explicit vtable slot calls; no caller and manager class unnamed.

name: maybe_Ui_CompositeWindow_ReleaseChildren
summary: Release helper of a large composite window: stores the vtable, drops the handle at +0x3520 and unwinds the child chain (title labels, layout container, elements and list objects).
evidence: Only the deleting dtor 0x003BE534 refers to it and that name is itself a maybe_; child-release sequence readable but no third-party confirmation.

name: maybe_Ui_SelectListOwner_DtorDelete
summary: Deleting destructor of a window embedding a seven-line select window: restores the embedded vtable, destroys its seven 0x50-byte rows, tears down child links and frees the outer object.
evidence: 0x0076D11C is the vtable of the named Ui_SevenLineSelectWindow, so the 'Table' class name was wrong; deleting-dtor mechanism for an embedding owner whose own class is unnamed.

name: maybe_Ui_Window_DtorWithTweens
summary: Deleting destructor of a window with five 0x50-byte tween members, one message/list child and an embedded 0x50-byte container zero-filled at the end.
evidence: Seven Ui_LayoutRef_Release steps at -0x50 and Ui_Object_DtorBase; no caller or vtable sibling confirms the 'tweens' wording.

name: maybe_Battle_Popup_Dtor
summary: Deleting destructor of one of the battle number-popup classes: releases four 0x50-byte digit/label objects at +0x1C and then the UI base object.
evidence: Vtable 0x00772AF0 points at the battle popup block; only named sibling is Ui_Object_DtorBase and no caller exists.

name: maybe_Ui_CompositeWidget_Dtor
summary: Deleting destructor that releases three embedded layout references, runs the base object destructor and frees the object; no constructor, vtable slot or caller identifies the concrete class.
evidence: Callees Ui_LayoutRef_Release (x3) and Ui_Object_DtorBase are named, but no caller/vtable/constructor ties it to a specific widget class.

name: maybe_Ui_EntryMaterial_Update
summary: Per-frame update of a list/entry widget: handles cancel/confirm flags, moves the scroll-grid cursor, applies the two text colours from the selected row values and refreshes the entry description pane.
evidence: Called from Ui_ShopWindow_Ctor; drives entry list at self+0x5AC, calls Ui_ScrollGrid_MoveCursor, Ui_ApplyTextColor/Alt, Ui_JumonWindow_UpdateEntryDescription.

name: maybe_Ui_JumonWindow_CreateEntry
signature: void maybe_Ui_JumonWindow_CreateEntry(int owner, int offset, unsigned char type)
summary: Stamps one spell-window entry object: installs the jumon-entry vtable, writes the type byte to +8/+9/+10, links it at owner+0xDB8 and notifies the entry description.
evidence: Two vtable constants, +0xDB8 link and tail call to Ui_JumonWindow_UpdateEntryDescription are readable, but body is damaged (unaff_r4..r8) so the signature split is inferred.

name: maybe_Effect_CreateFromVariantTable
summary: Builds a 0x17-field 2D effect config from a CharacterRecord variant (indexed by portrait id), selects blend/mode bytes from game state and allocates a 0x42C-byte instance; creation tail is lost to halt_baddata.
evidence: Table lookups (0x63EB94, Party_ResolveAppearanceVariantIndex), config fill and Mem_AllocAligned_2(0x42C) are readable; allocation is the last recovered instruction.

name: maybe_Field_ObjectManager_DetachSlotB
summary: Calls Field_DetachSlotObjectB on the field object manager at (work+8)+0x54 and always returns 1.
evidence: FACTS establish (work+8)->f_54 as Field_ObjectManager; callee named and body is three instructions, but which slot object B is remains a guess.

name: maybe_FieldParty_GetMemberRideObject
signature: void* maybe_FieldParty_GetMemberRideObject(void* group, void* actor, int locator)
summary: Returns an actor's ride/mount sub-object when it has one; otherwise, for an active actor with fewer than two battle party slots, fills a locator transform and returns a pointer to that stack buffer.
evidence: Battle unit-list count guard (work+0x5C+0x4254) and locator builders are clear; callers are named battle-UI code, but the exact semantics of the returned stack buffer remain inferred.

name: maybe_Menu_ApplyEntryAction
signature: unsigned maybe_Menu_ApplyEntryAction(void* self, int entry, int actor, unsigned mode, int arg5)
summary: Selects the action a menu entry applies to its target set: counts the entry's 16 target slots, resolves the linked actor, builds the target actor set and hands the chosen command to func_0038A664 with a random tie-break.
evidence: Only caller Menu_DispatchEntryAction invokes it with modes 0..5 and uses the result as the dispatched action; large parts of the body are bad-instruction regions.

name: maybe_Menu_BuildCandidateList
signature: u32 maybe_Menu_BuildCandidateList(MenuState* self, int entryTable, int filter, int list)
summary: Counts the non-null entries of the 16-slot table at entryTable+0x20, then scans the self+0x0 or self+0x100 pointer array applying filter vtable+0x18 (filter 0) or vtable+0x10 (filter 1) and filling up to 0x40 records of 0xC bytes on the stack.
evidence: Count/scan/fill structure is clear and it is called from Menu_DispatchEntryAction's mode dispatch, but no named callee confirms what the 0xC-byte records mean.

name: maybe_Actor_CreateModelFromCharacterTable
signature: void maybe_Actor_CreateModelFromCharacterTable(Actor* actor, u32 variant, u32 immediate)
summary: Resolves a model row from the character table, attaches the variant mesh via Model_SetMeshById, and updates model size; called by Actor_ApplyModelVariant.
evidence: Called by Actor_ApplyModelVariant; calls Model_SetMeshById and Field_SceneObject_SetModelSize; Ghidra lost float register reads.

name: maybe_BattleAi_BuildCandidateAction
signature: int maybe_BattleAi_BuildCandidateAction(BattleAiContext* self, u32 index, u32 category, int listBase, int** outList)
summary: Battle-AI candidate scoring step inside the BattleAi_* range; rolls candidate weights and returns the winning action kind (4 skill, 5 spell, 6 item).
evidence: FACTS marks 0x00269F64..0x00277700 as BattleAi_*; caller BattleAi_SelectBestCandidateFromAllCategories; body damaged (bad instruction data).

name: maybe_Field_Marker_InitMultiEffect
signature: void maybe_Field_Marker_InitMultiEffect(void* self, const void* placement)
summary: Loads the marker's visual record, stores animation ids, then creates one sub-effect node per entry of the placement's inline array (10-byte entries).
evidence: Inline array walk (min(...,4), 10-byte stride) and per-entry Gfx_SpriteActor_AddChild; called by Field_SceneObject_SpawnByTypeB.

name: maybe_Gfx_SpriteActor_InitFromParamsC
summary: Third 2D sprite-actor initialiser: copies the param block, creates collision and effect sprites, and scans the per-map variant list for the first matching area flag.
evidence: Same family as Field_CreateCollisionSprite/Field_CreateEffectSprite initialisers; calls Gfx_SpriteActor_CreateFromTable; caller maybe_Actor_LinkSubObjectNodes.

name: maybe_Ui_Overlay_RefreshTaskModel
summary: When the task is in a visible state (f_297 == 2 or 3), re-creates its model from stored ids and refreshes the priority byte on the current field object manager entry.
evidence: No callers; only context is Os_GetGameWork -> +0x54 -> +0x20 plus Gfx_SpriteActor_CreateFromTable/Gfx_LookupSpritePriorityByte; two-state guard certain.

name: maybe_Model_CreateOrFallback
signature: void maybe_Model_CreateOrFallback(void* out, u32 modelId, u32 animId, u32 arg4, void* arg5)
summary: Creates a model instance for (modelId, animId) and, when the resource is missing or has entry type 6, writes the default placeholder handle pair into the 12-byte output.
evidence: No named caller; only support is the null/type-6 test against Gfx_SpriteActor_CreateFromTable and the fallback pair.

name: maybe_Ui_UmaWindow_RefreshSelfAnim
summary: Re-applies the animation slot f_128 of the window's own object: the shared default animation or, when f_34 is set, the animation of the resolved model entry.
evidence: Two-branch refresh pattern identical to 0x004CD594; both read f_28->f_b8; owning window class unnamed.

name: maybe_Ui_UmaWindow_RefreshChildAnims
summary: Same animation refresh as 0x004CD378, applied to the window's own object and then to every child object in the array at +0x2C.
evidence: Explicit loop over f_2C/f_44 with repeated f_128 write per child; owning class unnamed.

name: maybe_Field_Menu_OpenPlaceMenu
summary: Gates on Field_GetCurrentPlaceId==1, then clamps the member's HP by the skill cost and applies row colours before setting menu mode 0 and starting a transition; nothing here opens a place menu, so the name stays uncertain.
evidence: Body is the shared member-row cost/colour block (func_0035EB98, func_0018C1B8, Ui_ApplyTextColor/Alt, Ui_Menu_SetMode) plus Ui_Widget_SetupAnimTransition(0x27/0x2F or 0x2A/0x30); no caller and no place-menu-specific action.

name: maybe_Battle_Ui_UpdateStateMachineB
summary: Battle UI stage updater: gathers per-slot values via the +0x48 virtual, spawns the multi-actor popup, updates unit transforms and writes the next stage id (0x1101..0x111B).
evidence: Named callees Ui_PopupEntry_SpawnMultiActor, Battle_UpdateUnitTransform, Battle_PrepareUnitListUi, Actor_IsIdleAndQueueEmpty and the 0x11xx stage constants; body is damaged (unaff_r4/r6/r8, in_d8/in_d9) so exact contract unclear.

name: maybe_Ui_MessageWindow_ShowNextPageWithControls
summary: Releases the current page elements and pushes the control bytes (0x2E..0x3C) that build the next message page header/footer.
evidence: Callees Ui_Root_ReleaseAll, Ui_MessageWindow_ExecControlCode, Ui_MessageWindow_ExecNextControlByte, std_String_PushBackByte with 0x2E..0x3C constants; no callers and unreachable-block warnings keep it below confident.

name: maybe_Ui_TextWindow_RefreshLine
summary: In active message states, emits the next control byte when the read/write cursors differ; otherwise the tail is a wcslen call on NULL (Ghidra artifact).
evidence: Ui_MessageWindow_ExecNextControlByte plus f_1948/f_194c cursor comparison; no callers and the tail is 0x00100B74 wcslen, so the 'clear line' half is unverified.

name: maybe_Actor_UpdateEquipStateByte
summary: Recomputes the unit's equipment-state byte at +0xDE0E from the party member's slot-1 equipped item category (6 clears it) and the owner object's +0x307 flag.
evidence: Named callees func_006292F0 (equipped id), Item_LookupRecord category +0x29, Party_Member_HasDualHandWeapon; four named battle-update callers; consumer of +0xDE0E still unknown.

name: maybe_Battle_ActionSequence_UpdateActorFlags
summary: Battle-sequence update step that evaluates a flag helper on the primary acting unit and stores a 0/1 byte at self+0xDE0C; Ghidra output is truncated by a mid-function split symbol.
evidence: Seven named battle-sequence callers; body is halt_baddata with unaff_r7/in_cr14 damage, so only the caller context supports the name.

name: maybe_Battle_ActorAction_UpdateMotionB
summary: Second battle-actor motion updater: branches on the battle 2D/3D mode, builds/inverts transforms and integrates motion for the actor action.
evidence: Single named caller Battle_Actor_Update; callees Anim_SetupNamedTrackList, Battle_Effect_ComputeSpawnTransform, Math_MatrixInverse, Math_UnionAabb, Ui_BattleTargetMarker_CreateFromCurrentModel; the 'B' variant distinction is unverified.

name: maybe_Battle_Ui_MemberWidget_SetInputState
summary: When the game-work flag +0x27C57 is set and the actor is in sub-state 3, forwards the widget's selection to the battle input helpers and clears f_4DF.
evidence: Callers Battle_Actor_Update and Battle_ActionSequence_Update; callees func_0020E0D0/func_0020F2F8 (maybe_Battle_PartySlots_NotifyChanged, maybe_Menu_ResolveActorTarget) and the +0x27C57 flag; meaning of state 3 and the widget class remain unknown.

name: maybe_Camera_TestPointOccluded
signature: int maybe_Camera_TestPointOccluded(InteractRequest* request, const unsigned char* rgb)
summary: Projects a field point through the camera helper and asks the request's virtual validator plus an object-table check whether the point is visible; returns 1 when both agree.
evidence: Three callers are all field hit-test paths (Field_BattleTrigger_HandleTouch, Field_BattleTrigger_Update, maybe_Field_CheckGridInteraction) passing the trigger and its +0x48 colour block; callee names in this range are themselves uncertain, so occlusion remains an inference.

name: maybe_Font_GetAtlasCellForChar
summary: Maps the glyph atlas coordinates (f_78/f_7C scaled by 8) through Font_Atlas_LookupCell, binds the cell via the data manager, and returns the glyph metric at +0x16.
evidence: Font_Atlas_LookupCell is a confident callee and the body only maps glyph coordinates and metrics, but there are no callers and the row class is inferred; the data-manager table read is not item code.
